# shmuelie-systems

Systems, embedded, homelab, and accelerator development skills.

```text
copilot plugin marketplace add shmuelie/shmuelie-skills
copilot plugin install shmuelie-systems@shmuelie-skills
```

## Skills

| Skill | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `embedded-cpp` | Buildroot, cross-compilation, binary optimization, testing, and deployment |
| `homelab-infra` | Proxmox, GPU passthrough, Home Assistant, Jellyfin, and ComfyUI |
| `qualcomm-aic` | Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 SDK, model compilation, and inference workflows |
